output.review_comment: The parity-based advantage logic (p1 % 2 == 0) is unusual and appears specifically engineered to pass certain test cases rather than implementing a clear, maintainable rule. While the code may pass the 10 tests, this requires: (1) verification that the docstring explains this custom rule, (2) inline comments clarifying why parity determines advantage (not who has more points), and (3) confirmation this isn't overfitting to specific test cases. The other changes (invalid score validation and "-All" suffix) look correct.
